tool.name: Consensus
tool.command:
mkdir pycytominer_output &&
## Since the strata are input as integers, they need to be converted in a a comma separated string columns_headers=`head -n1 "$profiles" | cut -d, -f'$replicate_columns'` &&
pycytominer consensus
--profiles '$profiles' --output_file './pycytominer_output/output.csv' --output_type 'csv' --operation '$operation' --replicate_columns "\$columns_headers"
&& cp './pycytominer_output/output.csv' '$output'

param.name: profiles
param.label: Input cell-profiling table
param.help: Table with features extracted from biological images, normally after feature selection

param.name: replicate_columns
param.label: Column with unique condition
param.help: Select column with the unique condition, meaning where replicates share all of these values

param.name: operation
param.label: Select operations
param.help: List of operation to apply to the cell-profiling table

tool.help:
**What it does**
**Pycytominer consensus** collapses replicate wells into one profile per biological condition by taking the median (or modz) across replicates.
- **median**, **mean**, or **Moderated z-score** (recommended for large screens)
